commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export
cat > "$base/bin/redact" <<'ANTRIEB_REDACT'
#!/usr/bin/perl
use strict;
use warnings;

while (my $line = <STDIN>) {
    $line =~ s{
        (\bauth_token\b[ \t]*(?:=|:)[ \t]*)
        (?:
            (["'])((?:\\.|(?!\2).)*)\2
          | ([^,\s;&}\]]+)
        )
    }{
        my ($prefix, $quote) = ($1, $2);
        $prefix . (defined($quote)
            ? $quote . '[REDACTED]' . $quote
            : '[REDACTED]');
    }egix;

    $line =~ s{
        [A-Z0-9.!\#\$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\@
        (?:[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?\.)+
        [A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?
    }{[REDACTED]}gix;

    print $line;
}
ANTRIEB_REDACT
cat > "$base/bin/export.new" <<'ANTRIEB_EXPORT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
logs_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$base/logs" && pwd -P)
redactor=$base/bin/redact
output=$1

if [ -L "$output" ]; then
    printf 'refusing symlink output directory: %s\n' "$output" >&2
    exit 65
fi
if [ -e "$output" ] && [ ! -d "$output" ]; then
    printf 'output is not a directory: %s\n' "$output" >&2
    exit 65
fi
mkdir -p -- "$output"
output_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$output" && pwd -P)

case "$output_root" in
    "$logs_root"|"$logs_root"/*)
        printf 'output must be outside logs/: %s\n' "$output_root" >&2
        exit 65
        ;;
esac

if find "$output_root" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
    printf 'output directory must be empty: %s\n' "$output_root" >&2
    exit 65
fi

find "$logs_root" -mindepth 1 -type d -print | LC_ALL=C sort |
while IFS= read -r source_dir; do
    relative=${source_dir#"$logs_root"/}
    mkdir -p -- "$output_root/$relative"
done

find "$logs_root" -mindepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) -print | LC_ALL=C sort |
while IFS= read -r source; do
    relative=${source#"$logs_root"/}
    input=$source

    if [ -L "$source" ]; then
        target=$(readlink -f -- "$source" 2>/dev/null || true)
        case "$target" in
            "$logs_root"/*)
                if [ ! -f "$target" ]; then
                    printf 'skipping non-file symlink: %s\n' "$relative" >&2
                    continue
                fi
                input=$target
                ;;
            *)
                printf 'skipping unsafe symlink outside logs/: %s\n' "$relative" >&2
                continue
                ;;
        esac
    fi

    mkdir -p -- "$output_root/$(dirname -- "$relative")"
    "$redactor" < "$input" > "$output_root/$relative"
    chmod --reference="$input" -- "$output_root/$relative"
    touch -r "$input" -- "$output_root/$relative"
done
ANTRIEB_EXPORT
chmod 0755 "$base/bin/redact" "$base/bin/export.new"

printf '%s\n' 'installed exporter and redactor'
